items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was he as good as Edmund Hall? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh no, no, he wasn't good at him... Now Edmund is a fella, look, in all the clan that played, he's the only fella picked up a clan that just went on and played.

ctx.x: Well when you started off, did you have a real horn or did you make your own horn?

No, I had a. When we first started playing, we made some instruments, you know? Or a reed, canned reed, you know? And we made a bass with some fishing rod, you know? And we had a little club, you know? We made a club, me and Ed, Robert Hall, Ed, and all the brothers, you know? And different other fellas got together and things like that, you know? So finally, well, you know, well, their daddy was a clarinet player. Well they wanted to learn how to play clarinet. So what we did, we bought a clarinet, ten dollars.…

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...me and Robert, Edmund Hall, all of us, learning together. [INTERVIEWEE] But we ain't nobody learning, we just learned it ourselves.

ctx.x: Did you play from music? Or just head numbers? No. We weren't using the music then.
No. When I first came here I went, you see, I learned when I played trumpet, we were all the boys at home, you know, me and Robert, Edmund Hall, all of us, learning together.
But we ain't nobody learning, we just learned it ourselves.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see.

ctx.x: Well tell us a little bit about it and then we'll ask him some more and we can think of other

questions. Well he, well you see he used to play in a band, he used to play the alto in the band. See? He used to play the alto in the band and then after that well he used to fool around with trumpet, trombone and song like that you know. He had one of them valve trombone you know what I mean? He had sliding trombone, trumpet and different things like that you know. So well and this boy, this Hall boy, daddy, well he used to play in the onward band here. See Edmund Hall daddy. Father yeah. Yeah he used to play…

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.

ctx.x: Tell him who was in the band, he'd like to know.
Oh yeah, well, Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.
